```{python}
# Setup: read the DuckDB-lab exports (demo data). Real deployment filters
# by week_start in SQL (see duckdb-lab/sql/timeseries.sql) — the exports
# below already represent one reporting window.
import duckdb
import pandas as pd

con = duckdb.connect()
num = con.execute(
    "SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('../duckdb-lab/data/eda_numeric_export.csv')"
).fetchdf()
hourly = con.execute(
    "SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('../duckdb-lab/data/hourly_export.csv')"
).fetchdf()
hourly["day"] = pd.to_datetime(hourly["hour"]).dt.date
daily = hourly.groupby("day", as_index=False)["ncalls"].sum()
```

## Scorecard

```{python}
#| label: tbl-kpi
#| tbl-cap: "Alarm-processing quantiles vs NFPA 1710 (64s p90 / 106s p95)"
from great_tables import GT

q = num["dispatch_queue_seconds"]
kpi = pd.DataFrame({
    "metric": ["p90 queue (s)", "p95 queue (s)", "median queue (s)", "total calls"],
    "value": [round(q.quantile(0.90), 1), round(q.quantile(0.95), 1),
              round(q.median(), 1), int(hourly["ncalls"].sum())],
    "target": ["<= 64", "<= 106", "info only", "info only"],
})
GT(kpi).tab_header(title="Processing & Volume Scorecard")
```

## Volume

```{python}
#| label: fig-volume
#| fig-cap: "Daily call volume for the reporting window"
from plotnine import ggplot, aes, geom_col, labs, theme_minimal

(ggplot(daily, aes(x="day", y="ncalls"))
 + geom_col(fill="#0077CC")
 + labs(x="Day", y="Calls")
 + theme_minimal())
```

Findings: volume is in @fig-volume and processing compliance in @tbl-kpi.
Rows failing the NFPA lines route to the shift scorecards
(`duckdb-lab/sql/audiences.sql`); data-quality flags route to QA.
